args.lesson: Topcoder fit closed as BOUNDED_UNKNOWN. Observed: the public challenge page is a 1989-byte JavaScript shell with no listing; the v5 API returned 404; the unauthenticated v6 challenges API returned an empty list [] for two status spellings. No open task, AI rule or payout term was readable, so nothing was implemented. What worked: checking the FETCH body size before delegating reading saved a turn. What failed: fetching a JS-rendered marketplace page. Next time, for bounty/marketplace platforms fetch a documented JSON/RSS endpoint first, and stop after one shell plus one empty API result. Scope: these requests only; it does not show Topcoder has no challenges. Pattern across Algora, Topcoder, Freelancer, python.org and WordPress jobs: every third-party paid-work route also needs a founder-authorized account/identity, so further platform fit scans add little until an identity decision or an inbound request exists.
